create_autoencoder_kl_flux2: create an AutoencoderKLFlux2 VAE instance with Flux2VAEConfig for encoding images into latents and decoding latents back to images
encode_images_to_latents: encode a batch of images into latent representations using the encode method with optional slicing and tiling
decode_latents_to_images: decode a batch of latent vectors back into images using the decode method with optional slicing
tiled_encode_images: tiled encode a batch of large images into latents using overlapping tiles to reduce memory usage
tiled_decode_latents: tiled decode a batch of large latent vectors into images using overlapping tiles to reduce memory usage
